I'm the accounts administrator at Harlow Build Supplies and I need an out-of-office auto-reply for my email. My notes:

- I'm off from Monday 23 November 2026 for exactly two weeks. (I'm having knee surgery, but nobody outside my team needs to know that, or anything else about why I'm away.)
- I'm back at my desk on the first Monday after those two weeks.
- While I'm away, invoice queries go to Tomasz on accounts@harlowbuild.example. He is only covering invoices, so don't suggest he can help with anything else.
- Everything else will wait until I'm back.
- My mobile is 07700 900152, but don't give that out.

Write the auto-reply as exactly five lines in this layout, with no other text (a blank line between lines is fine):
Line 1 is exactly: Thank you for your email.
Line 2 is in your own words: one or two sentences, kept on a single line. Line 3 is exactly the words "Invoice queries only:" then one space, then the email address for invoice queries, and nothing else.
Line 4 is exactly: Everything else will wait until I return.
Line 5 is exactly: Kind regards, Priya Nair

Rules:
1. Between 40 and 55 words in total, counting every word on all five lines.
2. Give no reason of any kind for my absence, and do not use the words "sorry", "unfortunately", "apologies", "leave" or "holiday".
3. No phone numbers, do not write the year anywhere, and do not name Tomasz or mention a colleague.

Reply with the auto-reply text only.

prompt:
My landlord sent our house this rambling message about the boiler. I want to turn it into a short card to tape inside the boiler cupboard for my housemates.

--- MESSAGE ---
Hi all, Gareth from Brightside Heating talked me through this on the phone so here goes. If the boiler locks out (red light flashing) you can reset it yourselves. The reset button is the one on the left under the flap, and you hold it in for 3 seconds, not longer. But before you touch that you need to check the pressure gauge, which should read between 1 and 1.5 bar. If it's under 1, open the silver filling tap under the boiler until the needle gets to 1.5 bar and then close the tap again, fully. Oh, and before any of that, turn the heating off at the wall thermostat. After you've pressed reset, wait 5 minutes before you turn the thermostat back up. Gareth says people always rush this bit and it locks out again within 30 seconds. If it fails twice don't keep trying, ring me on 01632 960114. Thanks, Moira
--- END ---

Write the card to this exact layout:
- Line 1 is exactly: BOILER RESET: 6 STEPS
- Then exactly six numbered lines, starting "1. " to "6. ", one step per line, in the order the steps must actually be carried out (which is not the order Moira mentions them in).
- Each step begins with a different one of these six verbs, so each verb starts exactly one step: Check, Close, Hold, Open, Turn, Wait.
- Each step is at most 12 words, not counting the number, with single spaces between words.
- The final line is exactly: If it fails twice, call 01632 960114.
- Eight lines in total. No blank lines, no other text, plain text with no bold or other markup.
- Between them the steps must include "under 1 bar", "1.5 bar", "3 seconds" and "5 minutes", written exactly like that.
- The word "thermostat" must appear in exactly two of the steps, once in each.
- Do not mention Gareth, Brightside Heating or Moira, and do not use the words "please" or "simply".

Reply with the card only.

I chair the Tannery Wharf residents' association in Leeds. Please write the notice for the lobby noticeboard about our annual general meeting. The details:

- The AGM is on Thursday 21 January 2027. Doors open at 6.45pm and the meeting starts at 7.15pm sharp. It is in the Community Room on the ground floor of Block C.
- Agenda: (1) the chair's report, (2) the accounts for the year, (3) election of the committee, (4) the lift replacement programme.
- People need to bring their fob (the Community Room door is fob-only now) and, if they want to vote, proof of address.
- Background for you only, not for the notice: the lift work has gone £38,000 over budget, and Councillor Reyes, who was due to speak, has pulled out.

1. Between 80 and 110 words in total, counting every word including the first and last lines and the labels.

6. In the Where: section, give the room, the floor and the block.
7. In the Bring: section, say that people need their fob and, in a separate sentence, that proof of address is needed to vote.
8. Do not mention the budget, any cost or sum of money, the councillor, or any guest or speaker.
9. The last line must be exactly: All residents welcome.

Reply with the notice only.
